He knows what it takes to please the masses, and the bigger the crowd the easier it is to work them. So much for that. Now, show us your best, my boy. Let imagination sing with all its choirs— reason, common sense, feeling and passion, too. Just don’t forget to throw in a little folly.

@@U00015@@
Not to mention plenty of action. It’s what they've come for, to see, to see things happen, its what they like. Unreel a string of actions before their eyes, make them gape in wonder, and you've got them where you want them, in the palm of your hand. Mass is what it takes to please the masses, mass and variety. In the end, everyone chooses what he most likes, and goes home happy. But whatever work you manage to put on, give it in pieces, serve it up like a ragout, and you'll have a success. It’s easy, as soon as it simmers you dish it out. Why give it to them whole when they'll pick it apart in any case?

@@U00017@@
How can you? How can you ask me this? I’m an artist,
translation:
@@U00013@@
他知道怎样才能取悦大众，而受众越多，就越容易吸引他们。就这么多了。现在，向我们展示你最好的一面吧，我的孩子。让想象力与它的所有合唱团一起歌唱——理性、常识、感觉和激情。只是不要忘记加入一些愚蠢的东西。

@@U00015@@
更不用说大量的行动了。这就是他们来这里的目的，就是为了看到、看到事情发生，这是他们喜欢的。在他们眼前展开一连串的动作，让他们目瞪口呆，然后你就可以将他们带到你想要的地方，就在你的手掌上。大众是取悦大众、大众和多样性所需要的。最后，每个人都选择了自己最喜欢的，高高兴兴地回家了。但无论你做了什么工作，把它分成几部分，像炖肉一样端上来，你就会成功。很简单，煮开后就可以出锅了。既然他们无论如何都会把它拆开，为什么要把它整个给他们呢？

@@U00017@@
你怎么能？你怎么能问我这个？我是一名艺术家，
